snippet.title: RoRX: Official Trailer, competitive strategy with simultaneous turns
snippet.description:
Hidden intentions, simultaneous impacts.
Wishlist RoRX on Steam: https://bit.ly/rorx_steam_ytb

RoRX is a competitive strategy game where both players plan in secret, then every order resolves at once. Build an army of Robots from over 200 cards, fight on hexagonal arenas and outthink your rival, not outclick them. Every card is earned by playing.

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/r8WdczQY9Y
Website: https://rorx.gg
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/rorx_official
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rorx_official/

Brutal Gears is a five-person French studio based in Aix-en-Provence.

#RoRX #StrategyGame #IndieGame
